'''Carlac''' was a peaceful, snow-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. A [[Ming Po town|town]] inhabited by members of the [[Ming Po/Legends|Ming Po]] culture existed on the planet during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. However, that village was [[Battle on Carlac/Legends|burned]] to the ground by [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], a radical [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[terrorist/Legends|Terrorist]] group.

==Description==
Carlac was a [[Water/Legends|snowy]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Its surface was covered in forests and mountains and its atmosphere was breathable to [[Human/Legends|humans]]. The planet had a cold climate<ref name="Ency" /> and was dotted with large pink cherry trees that in some instances dwarfed humans in size.<ref name="CWA" />

==History==
[[File:CarlacMingPoVillage-AFIN.png|thumb|left|250px|The [[Ming Po town]]]]
Carlac was largely untouched and neutral during the galaxy-wide conflict of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Ency" /> until the arrival of [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]]. Vizsla and his troops set up a [[Carlac Death Watch camp/Legends|camp]] near a local [[Ming Po town|town]] and forced the<ref name="AFIN" /> peaceful<ref name="Ency" /> [[Ming Po/Legends|Ming Po]] into servitude. It was here that [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] arranged to [[Battle on Carlac/Legends|meet]] with Vizsla and deliver the location of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], upon whom both Bonteri and Vizsla wanted vengeance.<ref name="AFIN" /> Though things quickly turned sour when Vizsla was warned to leave the planet by the [[Ming Po/Legends|Ming Po]] for abducting one of their own and continued harassments of the people. Much to the Chieftain's surprise, Vizsla agreed to leave camp and return his people back as soon as the next day.<ref name="AFIN" />

When Death Watch returned to [[Ming Po town]], Pre Vizsla brought along Lux Bonteri and Ahsoka Tano to watch as Pre Vizsla killed the Chieftain's grand daughter. Death Watch would later burn the village until Ahsoka Tano revealed herself to be a Jedi that would ultimately result in her capture. Though she would escape along with Lux Bonteri on the starship [[Phoenix (GX1 short hauler)/Legends|''Phoenix'']] with the help of [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and his small army of reassembled Death Watch shooting practice droids.<ref name="AFIN" />

Sometime after the events of Lux Bonteri's escape, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] shot down a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Munificent-class star frigate]]. A [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and the [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion]] under the command of [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]] arrived to finish off the remaining battle-droids near the crash site of the frigate. The Republic would later encounter the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] and lead a campaign against them as they fought to destroy many of Death Watch's camps on Carlac. Ultimately ending in the death of Sergeant [[Kellov]], [[Kherr Dawar]], [[Mord Jayran]] and [[Kro Lann]] and most importantly, Pre Vizsla and the remaining Death Watch to abandon the planet, eventually settling on [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]] and establishing a [[Zanbar Death Watch camp/Legends|camp]] there.<ref name="CWA" />
